methods.label: Work backward from the incorrect answer
methods.explanation:
Undo the mistaken operations in reverse order to recover the starting number. Just before dividing by \(3\), Cindy had \(43\cdot3=129\). This was the number after subtracting \(9\), so the starting number was \(129+9=138\).

Following the correct instructions would give
\[
\frac{138-3}{9}=\frac{135}{9}=15.
\]
Therefore her correct answer would have been \(\boxed{15}\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
